policies.versions_and_time: Equal mixture of Gold and Silver; equal morning/day/night mixture for land. Each original slot retains its own species, weight and level before duplicate aggregation. There is no version selector or time-of-day simulation in this whole-area scanner.
policies.multiple_floors: Where a single PNG combines original floors, the explicitly listed original floor pools are mixed equally. Unverified entrance identity is declared in the per-image decision instead of claiming a guessed exact floor.
policies.surf_levels: Original surf slots gain 0..4 levels. The source random-byte thresholds produce exact weights 89,76,51,26,14 out of 256; each resulting level is expanded separately.
policies.level_cap: Every original resulting level <=24 is kept fixed. Every original resulting level >24 rolls 21–24, matching the accepted v27 wild-level conversion. Authored extra-area ranges also stop at 24. Owned Pokémon leveling is untouched.
policies.varieties: Species and level are selected before the existing shared Vortex roll: Normal 311/336; Shiny, Dark, Mystic, Metallic and Shadow each 5/336. No extra variety or species override is introduced.
policies.unown_sprite: The six existing unlettered Unown pguide names receive byte-identical aliases of the six packaged A-form sprites. The Gold/Silver species remains Unown; letter unlocking and letter randomization are not simulated.
policies.step_rates: Source rates remain recorded as evidence. Runtime per-step chance is adapted for the common overworld grid: caves/ruins/towers 0.32, sea/lake/undersea 0.30, other outdoor habitats 0.28.
policies.terrain: One profile applies to an entire PNG area. Land is selected for mixed routes/caves; water for sea routes, Lake of Rage and the named Dragon’s Den water cavern. Towns and facilities remain quiet to avoid applying town surf tables across streets. Composite canvases cannot distinguish their furnished side rooms; this limitation is recorded per image where material.
policies.events: No roaming legendary, scripted gift, red-Gyarados guarantee, contest, fishing, headbutt or swarm override is added. Original ordinary Unown/Gyarados/Dratini slots remain where their source tables contain them. Quiet puzzles, roofs, hidden event chambers and facilities remain empty.
policies.extra_maps: Orange Islands, custom Alola labels, Faraway Zone, Archaic Enclosure, Dim Deep Cave and Undersea Lymph use explicitly authored Gen 1/2 habitat pools. Battle Frontier remains a quiet facility. No extra-area list is represented as canonical Gold/Silver data.

johto-adapted-alola-caves.note: Authored Gen 1/2 dry island cave pool for the custom Alola-labelled caverns; no original Gold/Silver location correspondence is claimed.

johto-adapted-alola-island.note: Authored Gen 1/2 tropical shore and island vegetation pool for the custom Alola-labelled map. This is a Johto-era species adaptation, not Sun/Moon data or Alolan forms.

johto-adapted-archaic-caverns.note: Authored Gen 1/2 cave/ancient ruin pool for the natural labyrinth caverns of Archaic Enclosure; sealed altar and facility rooms remain quiet.

johto-adapted-archaic-highlands.note: Authored Gen 1/2 dry highland and ruin-approach pool for Archaic Enclosure outdoor terrain; no canonical Gold/Silver area equivalence is claimed.

johto-adapted-dim-deep-caverns.note: Authored Gen 1/2 deep rocky cave pool for the custom Dim Deep Cave maps; Larvitar is rare ordinary cave wildlife, not a legendary.

johto-adapted-faraway-cavern-chambers.note: Authored Gen 1/2 rocky cave pool for the Faraway Zone canvas of ladder-linked cavern rooms separated by void. This extra map has no Gold/Silver source table.

johto-adapted-faraway-dusk-islets.note: Authored Gen 1/2 nocturnal/ghost habitat inferred from floating pink islands in a starry void; not a canonical encounter list or a source of random event legendaries.

johto-adapted-faraway-wetlands.note: Authored Gen 1/2 wetland and island grass pool for the Faraway Zone outdoor maps; Mew and other event legends are deliberately absent.

johto-adapted-navel-ice-mountain.note: Authored Gen 1/2 cold mountain/cave adaptation for Navel Island artwork; unrelated to a canonical Gold/Silver location.

johto-adapted-orange-tropical-woodland.note: Authored Gen 1/2 tropical woodland/coastal adaptation for the uploaded Orange Islands. These are habitat choices, not a claimed original Gold/Silver table; no regional form or legendary is invented.

johto-adapted-undersea-reef.note: Authored Gen 1/2 underwater reef pool for Undersea Lymph, an extra area without Gold/Silver underwater gameplay or canonical encounter data.

johto-adapted-volcanic-chasms.note: Authored Gen 1/2 volcanic/deep-earth cave pool inferred from the red rock and chasm artwork; no canonical Faraway Zone or Dim Deep Cave table exists.
